recipes.title: Match native C structure and union layouts
recipes.goal: Match a C struct or union when exchanging native aggregates; use runtime C layout on .NET 11 and verify size, alignment and offsets against the actual target ABI before calling native code.

selectionNotes: C layout is ABI-specific; validate against the actual native compiler, packing options and architecture.
Explicit older offsets remain valid for their stated ABI. Incorrect layouts are rejected without native invocation.
Union fields overlap; read only the member whose interpretation the native protocol defines. No ownership or marshalling is inferred.

packageAssets: Framework references/runtime; no new managed NuGet dependency.

stabilityLimitations: Actual RC2 verification, not final-GA proof; PIN-962 and PIN-959 remain open.
